newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - March 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - March 24.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

Leftwing Janatha Vimukthi Peramuna (JVP or People's Liberation Front) general-secretary Tilwin Silva says last week's local government poll shows party has emerged as third force in Sri Lankan politics. The JVP staged two abortive insurgencies in 1971 and 1988-90.
President Chandrika Kumaratunga says ruling People's Alliance coalition has been revitalised by last week's sweeping victory in local government poll.
Palestinian President Yasser Arafat arrives in Sri Lanka on Monday on two-day state visit.

Justice Minister G.L. Peiris says People's Alliance won nearly 51 percent of the vote, not just 49 percent, at Friday's local government poll when the votes received by independent groups backed by the ruling coalition are taken into account.
Former prime minister and opposition leader Ranil Wickremesinghe claims unprecedented rigging at last week's local government poll in which ruling People's Alliance won landslide victory.
